borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Internal alterations at lower ground floor level to include: remove kitchen units from rear room and create a new kitchen in front room with fixed cupboards and kitchen island, installation of new recirculating extractor hood to kitchen, removal of existing hearth, hob grate and fire surround from front room and replant in rear room, following refilling of chimney breast at high level, removal of small area of brick work to accommodate oven and extractor hood in front chimney breast, removal of modern low level cupboards in front room and install new ones in rear room either side of fireplace, replacement of two timber panels in front room door with fire rated glazing, remove shower enclosure in rear bathroom and replace modern units, and install new lighting scheme with wall lights/pendant lights to replace existing downlights; associated internal alterations.
